rationale: The description presents a security platform that connects data sources, generates insights, automates responses, and supports threat and incident handling; these are conventional security-platform functions as described, without an affirmative AI signal.
evidence_spans: IBM Cloud Pak for Security is an open security platform that connects to your existing data sources to generate deeper insights and enables you to act faster with automation. Whether your data resides on IBM or third-party tools, on-premises or multiple cloud environments, the platform helps you to find and respond to threats and risks - all while leaving your data where it is. So you can uncover hidden threats, make more informed risk-based decisions and respond to incidents faster.
